notice: Deterministic closed-world fictional fixture experiment. No model, GPU, provider, real inventory, people, or superiority/generalization claim.

protocol.hypothesis: Selective investigation and source-version reuse may reduce acquisition cost while retaining supported completion in an explicitly bounded fictional workstation system.
protocol.primary_comparison: decision_split versus information, both retaining identical current-version observations
protocol.reference: Exact minimum unrestricted expected-cost adaptive tree under the declared positive integer-weight prior. This is not a clairvoyant or budget-optimal oracle.
protocol.statistical_unit: Declared scenario structure; all worlds are an exhaustive finite enumeration, not independent people or tasks sampled from a population.
protocol.split_notice: Development and structural-check scenarios use different dependency structures. Policy definitions were written before this first frozen run. Authors inspect these results; this set is subsequently diagnostic, not a permanently untouched test set. No tuning or statistical superiority claim is supported by these few hand-authored structures.
protocol.decision_scope: Consensus on exact cheapest basket and its total, or infeasibility, within all declared worlds consistent with the observations. Other plausible real worlds are not covered. A budget stop is not a proven-infeasible decision.
protocol.cost_scope: Integer fictional acquisition-work units, not seconds, tokens, dollars, API calls or human effort. Prior observations are separately recorded sunk work shared by all policies; the restart ablation intentionally ignores their values.
